title: SandpaneCoreRpcRequest
description: Client → Core request frame (newline-delimited JSON over Unix socket / named pipe). Protocol version negotiated via system.probe.

v.description: Protocol version the client speaks. Current: 1.

id.description: Client-chosen correlation id, echoed verbatim in the response.

method.description: Allowlisted dotted method name. There is deliberately no free-form execution method.

params.description: Method-specific payload object ({} when empty). Validated per method; unknown/invalid shapes → VALIDATION_FAILED.
